title: Isomorphism of the free group factors

result.label: Isomorphism of the free group factors
result.statement: Resolves the free group factor isomorphism problem: L( F2) L( F3), and hence all interpolated free group factors, including L( F ), are isomorphic. Their common factor has fundamental group R 0 .
